page.overview:
Who is Charlotte Saint-Marc?

Charlotte Saint-Marc is the 22nd son and the 38th child of the Charlotte Family and an officer of the Big Mom Pirates. He also serves as Totto Land's , governing over Flavor Island. He is the older twin brother of Basans.

Saint-Marc is a very large man with tan skin, small head, and short hands. He wear a blue armor, with yellow epaulettes, red and white striped round elbow pads, and large blue gloves. He dons a purple cape with pink edges on his front, with a picture of a skull with an arrow pointing up. He also wear a blue Centurion helmet with a blue top that have two ivory straight horns on each side.

Not much is known about Saint-Marc's personality, however, since he took part in Big Mom's plan to assassinate the Vinsmoke Family, he can be considered very loyal to his family and crew.

As the Minister of Essence, Saint-Marc has authority over Flavor Island, and as an officer of the Big Mom Pirates, he has authority over lower-ranking members of his crew.
